pick.name: Distill.io (free)
pick.why: No server to keep running (laptop is not always on), and 25 monitors covers a solo founder's competitor set.
pick.free_limits: Free: 25 monitors (5 cloud), 1,000 cloud checks/mo, min interval 6 h, 30 email alerts/mo. Starter $15/mo

alts.name: changedetection.io
alts.what: Open-source page-change monitor, self-host or hosted
alts.why: Best if you already run a small always-on box (free) or want hosted for $8.99/mo with no monitor cap.
alts.install: docker run -d --restart always -p "127.0.0.1:5000:5000" -v datastore-volume:/datastore --name changedetection.io dgtlmoon/changedetection.io

alts.name: Visualping (free)
alts.why: Faster interval on free (60 min) but only 5 pages and free is marketed to individuals.

candidates.name: Wappalyzer free
candidates.verdict: 50 tech lookups/mo: use for 'what stack/tools does the competitor run'

decision: Distill's free cloud monitors plus local extension monitors need no infrastructure. Move to hosted changedetection.io ($8.99/mo) or self-host it when you want unlimited monitors and webhooks into your own stack.

verify.note: All Distill free numbers and Starter $15/mo confirmed.
